title: Animal Sciences - Pre-Veterinary Medicine/Science Option
sourceText:
ANIM SCI 101

ANIM SCI 180

CHEM 105 [PSCI]

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

MATH Requirement
MATH requirement may be satisfied by completing MATH 106 and 108, 140 [QUAN], or 171 [QUAN].

BIOLOGY 106 [BSCI]

CHEM 106

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

MATH Requirement, and/or Electives
MATH requirement may be satisfied by completing MATH 106 and 108, 140 [QUAN], or 171 [QUAN].

BIOLOGY 107

CHEM 345

H D 205 [COMM] or COM 102 [COMM]

Lab Management Requirement
Lab Management Requirement courses (One course) include ANIM SCI 166, 172, 174 (Fall-only), 178, 280 (Spring only).

UCORE Inquiry
Must complete 3 of these 4 UCORE designations:  ARTS, DIVR, EQJS, HUM.

ANIM SCI 240

MBIOS 303

STAT 212 [QUAN], 412, or PSYCH 311 [QUAN]
Students who have not yet completed a [QUAN] course should select STAT 212 or PSYCH 311.

VET PH 308

Electives

Complete Writing Portfolio

ANIM SCI 313

ANIM SCI 330

ANIM SCI 380

MBIOS 301

200-300-level ANIM SCI Electives
200-300-level ANIM SCI Electives: Select two courses from: ANIM SCI 205, 260, 266, 267, 274, 285, 314, 315, 345, 360, or as approved by advisor.

ANIM SCI 350

ANIM SCI 351

ECONS 101 [SSCI] or ECONS 102 [ SSCI] or ECONS 198

PHYSICS 101

PHYSICS 111

ANIM SCI 464 [CAPS] [M], 466 [CAPS] [M], 472 [CAPS] [M], or 474 [CAPS] [M]
Students may substitute ANIM SCI 474 [CAPS] [M] in the spring.

400-level ANIM SCI Electives
400-level ANIM SCI Electives: Select three courses from ANIM SCI 408 [M], 440 [M], 451 [M], 454, 460, 464 [M], 466 [M], 468 [M], 472 [M], 474 [M], 481, 485 [M], or 488 [M] not used to fulfill a major requirement, or as approved by advisor. Students are required to complete two [M] courses to meet University requirements.

Electives
Elective courses should include sufficient credits and 300-400-level coursework to meet the University requirement of 120 credits and 40 credits of upper-division coursework.

400-level ANIM SCI Electives [M]
400-level ANIM SCI Electives: Select three courses from ANIM SCI 408 [M], 440 [M], 451 [M], 454, 460, 464 [M], 466 [M], 468 [M], 472 [M], 474 [M], 481, 485 [M], or 488 [M] not used to fulfill a major requirement, or as approved by advisor. Students are required to complete two [M] courses to meet University requirements.

Newly matriculated students may be admitted to the animal sciences major upon making their intention known to the department.

Current students seeking admission to the major must have a cumulative GPA of 2.0 or better and be in good academic standing with the University.
